title: Arup Das & Ors. v. State of Assam & Ors.
bench: Altamas Kabir aur Surinder Singh Nijjar, JJ. (faisla: Altamas Kabir, J.)
summary: Assam Survey and Settlement Training Institute ki 160 seats vigyapit hui. Director ne baad mein teen aur select lists bheji (kul 690 seats uplabdh batakar), par Government ne manzoori nahi di.
held: Authority vigyapit sankhya se zyada chayan ya niyukti nahi kar sakti, chahe zyada post uplabdh hon. Aisa karna Article 14 aur 16 ke khilaaf hai, kyunki jo log aavedan nahi kar paaye unhe mauka hi nahi mila (para 10). Prem Singh ka apvaad sirf "exceptional" ya "emergent" sthiti aur policy decision ke saath hai (para 12). SLPs dismissed.
use: Para 10: zyada post uplabdh hona bhi vigyapit sankhya se upar chayan ko sahi nahi thehrata.
Para 12: Prem Singh (1996) ka apvaad seemit hai. State ko dikhana hoga ki sthiti asaadhaaran thi aur policy decision liya gaya.
caution: State 'anticipated vacancies' ka tark de sakti hai (para 8 mein Prem Singh ka hawala). Vigyapan mein kya likha tha, dekhna zaroori.
